answer: Mechanism: Saffron-Delta Marble Pacing. On first contact, each agent gets a per-identity saffron seed defining a required inter-arrival delta distribution and burstiness envelope (marble-shaped: alternating short/long gaps). A gateway scores live traffic against that envelope for 10 minutes; transactions unlock only after sufficient shape-match. Sybils must run many independent, low-latency pacing loops with distinct seeds and avoid shared egress patterns; the attacker pays CPU, bandwidth, and concurrency overhead proportional to identities, and batching causes detectable envelope correlation.
